name: cog-reporting
description: Claude Code only: reporting for COG (Claude Observability GUI). Telemetry module records per-request, per-tool, per-turn and per-subagent data as JSONL for COG to ingest; /cog-telemetry shows what has been collected.

outputDir.title: Output directory
outputDir.description: Where event files are written. Empty uses <Claude config dir>/cog (~/.claude/cog).

flushSeconds.title: Flush interval (seconds)
flushSeconds.description: How often queued events are written to a new file.
